evidence: Walked all 56 criteria (gates 1+1, functional 44, polish 5, visual 5). Every functional and polish criterion names a concrete observable outcome with durable evidence and a distinctive probe; none relies on a source read (all prompts line 1: 'Never inspect app source, bundles, filesystem, database files'), on 'looks right', or on a response shape alone. Durable evidence: state is re-read in an independent browser context (gate snippet browser.newContext(), functional prompt.md:11) for hro_job_open, hro_add_candidate, hro_arrive_bottom, hro_reorder, hro_bulk_move, hro_undo_restores, hro_notes (Aud), hro_activity (Aud), hro_msg_exchange (Tomas), and across a real restart_app for hro_restart (prompt.md:51). Refusal rows require 'nothing changed' re-reads plus a same-kind positive control (prompt.md:13,17,19; e.g. hro_bulk_all_or_none, hro_undo_conflict, hro_mgr_early_refused, hro_observer_readonly, hro_anonymous) and Activity no-line evidence (hro_activity_refusals). Distinctive probes: per-review suffixed job/card names (prompt.md:15), labelled cards A-F/V-Z/A2 with exact expected orders (Y, W, X; A2, V; Y, W, X, Z, A2), seeded probes verified in seed_data.json (Platform Engineer Applied Greta Lindqvist/Ade Bello/Marco Rossi positions 1-3, Screen Priya Nair/Samuel Ortiz; note 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.'; Lena APP-301 3 messages with read_count 2 -> 1 unread; APP-101 120 messages numbered '(#001)'..), polish probe 'Call back on Fri' absent from seed and solution (grep hit only polish/judge.toml). Time-varying outcomes are measurable: 15-second no-reload windows (hro_live_board, hro_unread_counts, hro_seen), document.activeElement (hro_refused_put_back, hro_pol_live_board/thread), getBoundingClientRect().top (hro_pol_earlier_place), single-request abort/offline with 'sent once' readback (hro_pol_failed_send). Status-only row hro_refusal_status grades the public 401/403/404/409 contract (hireops_rules.md section 1, 'Two people at once') while explicitly delegating state checks to the owning rows, so it is not a response-shape-without-state-change defect. Candidate privacy (hro_candidate_private) is decided on browser-received responses including websocket/EventSource payloads (prompt.md:43). Visual rows are likert with five described anchors on named surfaces (visual/prompt.md:14); this is craft judgement owned by check 41, not a 'looks right' functional criterion - Note only. Adversarial: a browser-only/localStorage store fails gate and independent-context reads; a full re-render poller that wipes note/focus/scroll fails hro_pol_live_board; undo that checks only stage changes fails hro_undo_conflict reorder leg; drafts keyed only by conversation fail hro_pol_session_resume Mei leg; observer-counted seen fails hro_seen. Residual P3 ambiguity (not a confirmed defect): hro_seen's last leg ('his next one after Rafael opens it', functional/judge.toml:362; protocol U prompt.md:41) does not tell the judge to close or move Bill's independent context; if Bill's page is left open on that conversation at its newest message, a rules-conforming app (hireops_rules.md 'if they are at the newest message, it is shown and counts as read') marks Tomas's next message seen before Rafael opens, which a judge could read as 'seen too early'. The shared snippet 'close only ctx afterwards' (prompt.md:11) makes closure the likely default, so this stays P3. Risk=true because no full configured judge run exists (raw-evidence-index scope: 'Full configured grading/workload ... absent'); the scripted golden observations (workspace.json, hash verified) are not judge decidability evidence.
counterexample: Not a Fail. Possible conforming-app false negative: judge opens Bill's independent context for hro_seen and leaves it on Tomas's J2 conversation at its newest; Tomas's final message is marked read by Bill immediately and shows seen before Rafael opens it, and the judge scores hro_seen 0 as 'seen too early'.
suggested_fix: Optional hardening: in protocol U add 'close Bill's context (or move it off that conversation) before Tomas sends one more' so the Rafael-opens leg is the only possible reader.
